title: A novel tool for visualizing chronic kidney disease associated polymorbidity: a 13-year cohort study in Taiwan
authors: **Huang CW**, Syed-Abdul S, Jian WS, Iqbal U, Nguyen PA, Lee P, Lin SH, Hsu WD, Wu MS, Wang CF, Ma KL, Li YC
journal: Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association 22(2):290–298
summary_zh: 以健保資料庫百萬人抽樣檔（1998–2011）追蹤慢性腎臟病病人，把確診前後的共病組合與透析、死亡等結局對齊在同一條時間軸上，畫成可互動縮放的 Sankey 圖。臨床人員能一眼看出哪些共病組合走向哪些預後，可用於臨床預估、醫學教育與預防策略。
summary_en: Using a one-million-person sample of Taiwan's National Health Insurance data (1998–2011), we aligned each CKD patient's comorbidities before and after diagnosis on one timeline and drew them as an interactive, zoomable Sankey diagram. Clinicians can see at a glance which comorbidity combinations lead to which outcomes, supporting prognosis, medical education, and prevention.
